en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 9. Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Mu`addab (RA) said: Ahmad ibn `Ali al-Ansari said, on the authority of ~Abd al-Salam ibn Salih al-Hirawi that Abu al-Hasan `Ali ibn Musa ibn Ja`far (AS) said:
Do not give charity or accept the testimony of someone who believes in determinism.
Verily, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, does not burden not burden a soul with more than it can bear. No bearer of a burden shall bear the burden of another.
